<function name="rad" parent="math" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Converts an angle in degrees to it's equivalent in radians.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="degrees" type="number">The angle measured in degrees.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">radians</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Convert various angles in degrees to their equivalent in radians.</description>
	<code>
print( "Degrees: 360, Radians: " .. math.rad( 360 ) ) -- 2*pi
print( "Degrees: 180, Radians: " .. math.rad( 180 ) ) -- pi
print( "Degrees: 90, Radians: " .. math.rad( 90 ) ) -- pi/2
print( "Degrees: 1, Radians: " .. math.rad( 1 ) ) -- pi/180
	</code>
	<output>
Degrees: 360, Radians: 6.2831853071796


Degrees: 180, Radians: 3.1415926535898


Degrees: 90, Radians: 1.5707963267949


Degrees: 1, Radians: 0.017453292519943
	</output>

</example>
